The compact base diameters maximize festive spirit without consuming valuable floor space in smaller living areas. Ideal for urban dwellers seeking maximum impact with minimal footprint.

5058194837501.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Suspend it in your bedroom for a dreamy nightlight, display it in the living room as a festive centerpiece, or hang it on the patio to welcome guests with a warm glow. Its classic design blends seamlessly into any setting, adding a touch of sparkling brilliance to Christmas.
【The Perfect Christmas Gift for All Ages】: Looking for a special present? This whimsical balloon light is the ideal Christmas Gift for family, friends, neighbors, or even as a hostess gift for holiday parties. Christmas Window Decorations - Christmas Window Clings will bring an enchanting and festive touch to your home!

9 Sheets Christmas Window Clings, specially designed with Christmas elements, such as Santa Claus, elk, Snowman, Snowflake and so on. The decals with white tones that appropriate to the tone of the winter season, the holiday spirit arrives instantly.

Window Christmas decals are suitable for household Christmas decorations. A wonderful DIY project to decorate home, office, school, cars, refrigerators, walls, perfect for Christmas party, winter wonderland party and Holiday indoor decorations.

Specifications:
Material: PVC
Pieces: 146
Package Include: 9 sheets（20cm*30cm/7.87in*11.8in)

Using Guide:
1. Make sure the surface is smooth and without any texture(like mirror and glass). Or the air will into the gap between the clings and surface then make the clings fall off.
2. Clean the surface to make sure there is no dust and grease on the surface.
3. Spray a little water on the surface. Water will make them stick better.
4. Put the clings on and remove the remaining water.
CHRISTMAS WINDOW CLINGS: Embrace the holiday spirit with 146 pieces Christmas window decals, featuring Santa Claus, Christmas trees, reindeer, snowmen, gift boxes, and an array of snowflakes. These decals are essential for creating the perfect festive scene
PREMIUM MATERIAL: Utilizing electrostatic adsorption, these decals require no glue, making them easy to apply and remove without leaving any residue. Crafted from non-toxic PVC, they are 100% reusable, waterproof, and double-sided for added effect
SIMPLE APPLICATION: Start by cleaning your window surface, then spray a little water on the glass. Peel off the stickers and place them where you like—it's that easy! Perfect for DIY Christmas decorating, these clings will brighten your home year after year
UNIQUE DESIGN: Featuring a variety of charming Christmas elements like Santa Claus, snowman, and reindeer in elegant white tones, these decals transform your living space into a magical winter wonderland. The 3D design adds a lifelike touch to your decor
VERSATILE USE: Ideal for festive decorating, these clings can be applied to windows, mirrors, tiles, refrigerators, walls, cabinets, and shop windows. They bring warmth and joy to your Christmas celebrations, creating an atmosphere that children will love
Indoor Use

8941467526301.baseName: 6 Pack Burgundy Velvet Christmas Cabinet Bows Ribbon for Kitchen Cupboard Door Window Fireplace
8941467526301.variantName: 6 Pack Burgundy Velvet Christmas Cabinet Bows Ribbon for Kitchen Cupboard Door Window Fireplace
8941467526301.sourceDescription:
You will receive 6 burgundy velvet cabinet door bows, each with a centre bow of about 9.8 x 7 in (25 x 18 cm). The ribbon measures about 3.28 ft (1 m) per tail, and with two tails each bow gives a total length of about 6.56 ft (2 m), which is enough to dress a run of kitchen cupboard doors or a mix of doors and drawers.

The bows are made from soft velvet fabric with a sealed lock edge finish, so the cut edges stay neat and the shape holds its fullness. A hidden steel wire inside each bow keeps it standing upright instead of flopping forward against the door. Hook and loop fasteners on the back let you press the bow into place and lift it off again without leaving marks, and you can gather the ribbon to the size that suits your cabinet.

Tie or stick them to kitchen cabinets, wardrobe doors, windows, fireplaces, stair rails and the Christmas tree, indoors or in a sheltered spot outside. They also suit weddings, banquets and birthday parties, and can be left up as everyday decoration once the season is over.

Velvet creases easily and the ribbons are folded for transit, so a bow may arrive with soft wrinkles. A quick press with an iron on a low setting removes them without affecting the shape, and slight differences in shade between screens are normal. Keep the ribbons out of reach of young children because of the winding risk.

0070621265201.sourceDescription:
For Christmas：Christmas tree star, specially designed for Christmas decoration. suitable for Christmas trees of various sizes on the market to meet your needs. Use this beautiful Christmas tree star to create your own unique Christmas tree, create a strong Christmas atmosphere, enjoy the Christmas season and celebrate with family and friends.

Guality materials：Made of rust-proof iron wire, covered with gold powder, and with a 3D hollow structure, it has a good visual effect from any angle. With the combination of ribbons and bells, it has a stunning visual effect under the lights of Christmas. High-quality materials, sturdy and durable, can be reused if used properly, and is competent for annual Christmas decoration.

Easy to use：The bottom of the tree star is connected to a conical spring base, so that the tree star can be easily installed on the top of the Christmas tree without the need for additional fixings. At the same time, it also has a certain adaptability and shock resistance, and can be stably maintained on the top of the Christmas tree, and will not fall off or be blown crooked by the wind easily. 8061543305801.sourceDescription:
Production Features:
1.This Christmas diamond painting ornament set includes 18 pieces, featuring classic festive patterns: gingerbread man, candy cane, star, Christmas tree, reindeer cupcake and gingerbread house.
2.It comes with glossy pearls and special-shaped resin gems, creating vivid 3D sparkling effects, which look richer than ordinary flat Christmas crafts.
3.Beginner-friendly DIY kit with clear printed patterns, easy to operate, no craft experience required.
4.Each ornament adopts lightweight wooden base with smooth edges, pre-applied adhesive and pre-drilled hanging holes.
5.Equipped with jute twine for hanging freely, suitable for decorating Christmas tree, wreath, window, door handle and gift packages. Great for holiday craft activities and handmade Christmas gifts.

Production Specification:
1.Material: Wood
2.Total Quantity: 18 pcs
3.Patterns: gingerbread man, candy cane, star, Christmas tree, reindeer cupcake, gingerbread house
4.Application: Christmas DIY crafts, festive decoration

Package Includes:
18 x wooden diamond painting ornament

NOTE:
1.Slight color difference may occur due to monitor settings; actual product prevails.
2.Manual measurement may cause a small size deviation; please refer to the actual item.
[18Pcs Christmas Ornaments Set]: This set includes 6 round wooden designs: gingerbread man, candy cane, star, Christmas tree, reindeer cupcake and gingerbread house. Classic festive patterns create a charming handmade Christmas tree theme.
[DIY Diamond Painting Kit]: Create eye-catching diamond art Christmas ornaments with glossy pearls and special-shaped resin gems. The dimensional sparkle reflects festive lights beautifully, giving a richer look than flat Christmas crafts.
[Beginner Friendly Craft]: Designed for beginners and craft lovers, these Christmas ornament kits use clear printed patterns and simple step-by-step placement. No experience needed—just match the gems and create sparkling handmade ornaments.
[Durable Wooden Base & Ready To Hang]: Each pearl art Christmas ornament has a lightweight wooden base with smooth edges, pre-applied adhesive and a pre-drilled hanging hole. Add the included jute twine and display on trees, wreaths or windows.
[Craft Hang and Display]: Attach the supplied twine after completing the designs, then hang the ornaments from a Christmas tree, garland, wreath, window, door handle or gift package. Suitable for festive craft sessions and handmade seasonal gifts.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Hanger included

5056797098701.variantName: MySmartBuy 10m Smart RGB Cluster Lights, Silver Wire, App and Remote
5056797098701.sourceDescription:
Take your Christmas lighting to the next level with these 10m smart RGB cluster lights from MySmartBuy. Bright micro LEDs on a sleek silver cable can be set to any colour, creating personalised light shows indoors and out. Use the Hello Fairy app or remote to choose from 16 million colours, sync to music, set timers and run dynamic effects. Ideal for trees, homes and gardens. The sleek silver cable blends neatly into Christmas trees, banisters, mantelpieces and garden shrubs, while the bright micro LEDs pack plenty of colour along the 10m length. Set timers so they come on automatically, or sync them to music for a festive party light show. Festive lights are among the most versatile decorations you can own. Use them to outline windows and doors, wrap trees and railings, or layer them with light up figures and wreaths to tie a whole display together. Versatile and easy to use, they are a quick way to transform your home and garden for the festive season, and can be brought out again year after year. At a glance: 10m smart RGB cluster lights | micro LEDs | silver cable | 16 million colours | music sync, timers and effects | Hello Fairy app and remote | indoor and outdoor use.
10M SMART RGB CLUSTER LIGHTS : Bright micro LEDs on a sleek silver cable.
PERSONALISED LIGHT SHOWS : Create stunning festive displays.
APP AND REMOTE CONTROL : Change colours, effects and brightness from your phone with the Hello Fairy app or the included remote.
16 MILLION COLOURS : With music sync, timers and dynamic effects.
INDOOR AND OUTDOOR USE : Decorate trees, homes and gardens.

1. Core Specifications & Design
Size & Shape: 90cm in diameter, round. It fits most small to medium Christmas trees, providing full coverage for the base without taking up excess floor space.
Dual Function: Works as both a tree skirt (to dress up the base) and a rug (to add softness underfoot). It serves decor and practical needs in one piece.
Decor Focus: Targets the "empty" area under the tree. It hides unsightly plastic/metal stands, making your Christmas tree look more polished and cohesive with surrounding decor.

Boost Holiday Vibe: Adds a classic Christmas touch. Whether paired with lights, ornaments, or wrapped gifts, it enhances the seasonal atmosphere—suits traditional, modern, or rustic themes.
Protect Floors: Acts as a barrier between the tree stand and your floor. It prevents scratches on wood/tile and catches fallen pine needles (for real trees) or small decor debris.
Easy to Use: Features a split design with simple fasteners (e.g., Velcro, ties). Wrap it around the tree base, secure it in seconds, and it’s ready—no tools required.
3. User-Friendly Details
Lightweight & Storable: Thin yet durable material folds flat for compact storage after the holidays. It takes up minimal space and retains its shape for yearly reuse.
Versatile Placement: Beyond the tree base, it can be used as a small accent rug near fireplaces or entryways. It extends festive decor to other parts of your home easily.

5058194864101.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive fabric wreath designed to add a practical decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Creates a focal point for your arrangement, allowing its outline and details to remain clearly visible.
Versatile decoration suitable for coordinating with existing room colours and textures during the holiday season.
Single set includes one festive door decoration crafted from durable fabric for seasonal home styling.

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and blue finish and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Pine Cone Detail
Pine cone details add texture among the festive foliage. Their recognisable shapes help create a woodland inspired arrangement, making the decoration easy to coordinate with other natural looking Christmas accessories.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Metal. Colour: Green and Blue. Stated size: 180 x 30 x 30 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Timer function allows you to set automatic on and off periods for convenient festive lighting.
Metal construction with green and blue finish provides a durable and defined festive appearance.
Pine cone details add natural texture and woodland-inspired charm to your Christmas display.
Compact hanging design fits easily into various home settings without requiring complex assembly.

Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use

Standing at 60cm tall, it’s a substantial decoration that looks fantastic by the fireplace, next to a Christmas tree, or in a window display where its humorous design can be enjoyed by all.
Battery-powered LED operation allows flexible placement anywhere in your home without the need for wires or sockets, perfect for creating effortless festive ambience and light.

5059442204601.variantName: Fraser Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 5ft (150cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 5ft
5059442204601.sourceDescription:
With its classic Christmas-tree shape and naturally dense growth, a pot-grown Fraser Fir makes a traditional choice for the festive season while offering something extra beyond December. The rich green foliage forms neat layers of branches that are easy to decorate, while the short, soft needles and good needle retention help it remain an attractive feature throughout the celebrations. This real Christmas tree has also been grown in a pot from the outset, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container before sale.
CLASSIC CHRISTMAS CHARACTER: Naturally conical and densely branched, Fraser Fir has the traditional Christmas-tree shape many people look for, with rich green foliage that creates a full appearance without needing excessive decoration. The branches provide plenty of room for lights, baubles, and other festive favourites.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
SOFT NEEDLES, LASTING DISPLAY: Fraser Fir has relatively soft needles that are pleasant to handle when decorating, while its needle retention helps it maintain a full appearance throughout the festive period. The foliage also releases a fresh, characteristic fir fragrance, adding another familiar part of the real Christmas tree experience.
FROM CHRISTMAS TREE TO GARDEN TREE: Once Christmas is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue caring for it as it grows. Fraser Firs are excellent evergreen trees for garden, bringing year-round foliage and structure rather than having its role end when the decorations come down.
ENJOY IT AGAIN IN YEARS TO COME: Caring for a pot-grown tree between Christmases gives it the opportunity to return to your home for future celebrations. Keep it growing outdoors during the rest of the year, and this potted real Christmas tree can become a Christmas tradition that grows with you, rather than a tree bought and replaced each season.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
